usedFor: Google Docs holds the writing, and Harvestr receives it as an inbox message through “Create Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document Created” in Google Docs, then “Create Message” in Harvestr
bestTemplate.why: Every new document becomes an inbox message, so notes written in docs reach the feedback pile.

watchOut: “New Document Created” in Google Docs is polling, so a new document appears in Harvestr after a scheduled check.
